item.title: Hyperia City goes on general release while Amber/Emerald finishes the old format on top
item.description: Set 14, Hyperia City, went on general release October 23 after prereleases began October 16. It brings in Pixar's Coco and adds the new one-use ink drops mechanic. • The last big pre-Hyperia events (October 10-11) belonged to Amber/Emerald: 3 wins and 8 podium spots across five events, including a full podium sweep at the 142-player CCQ Sevilla. • The first look at the Set 14 meta comes from the Quest World Iconic Clash, a 16-player invitational. Amber/Emerald Songs, Emerald/Amethyst Retro, Emerald/Steel and Amber/Steel Rockstar Stitch are all among the 16 decklists. • Set 15, Into the Inkdark, is due February 12, 2027. It brings Collector Boosters and a new serialized top rarity called Illustrious, sold only through Play Hub stores, Ravensburger's online store and some Disney locations. • Unlike Wilds Unknown and the set before it, Hyperia City is easy to find at or near MSRP in the US, though some players abroad and at certain stores still struggle to get product.
